message.content:
Deep-audit the InkOS codebase at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS` to support a 12-sprint, production-grade UI/UX hardening program. This is for planning — not coding. Be thorough; I'd rather have too much detail than too little.

Return the following as structured sections:

## 1. FULL PAGE INVENTORY
List EVERY page under `app/` with file path and route. Group by area:
- Public / auth (`app/(auth)/*`, `app/page.tsx`, `app/book/*`, `app/consent/*`, `app/invite/*`, `app/ai-design/shared/*`)
- Authenticated app (`app/(app)/*`)
- Admin (`app/admin/*`)
- Error boundaries, not-found, layouts

For each page: note the route, the file, and a 1-line description of what it does. I need the complete map.

## 2. COMPONENT INVENTORY
- `components/ui/*` — list every shadcn/base primitive
- `components/app/*` — list every domain component by area (sidebar, header, bookings, clients, commissions, consent, inventory, payroll, reports, settings, admin, shared, etc.)
- Count how many files are in each area

## 3. DESIGN TOKEN SYSTEM
Read `app/globals.css` — report the full `@theme inline` block. List every token:
- Colors (primary, secondary, accent, muted, destructive, chart colors, sidebar colors)
- Radii
- Shadows (soft, soft-md, card)
- Font families / sizes if defined
- Any custom animation / easing tokens
Note any raw hex values outside `--color-ink-black` / `--color-electric-purple`.

## 4. DARK MODE
- Does the app actually support dark mode? Check `ThemeProvider` config and whether tokens have dark variants.
- Is it tested? Any obvious dark-mode-broken components?

## 5. RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS
- Scan for responsive utility usage (`sm:`, `md:`, `lg:`, `xl:`) and identify any pages that look desktop-only (no mobile treatment).
- Are there any mobile-specific components (bottom sheets, drawers)?

## 6. ACCESSIBILITY
- `aria-label` usage count
- `role` usage count
- Any obvious a11y gaps (images without alt, buttons without labels, inputs without labels)

## 7. ANIMATION / MOTION
- Is `framer-motion` or `motion` installed?
- Any uses of `tw-animate-css`?
- Are there page transitions? Loading states? Skeletons?

## 8. LOADING + EMPTY + ERROR STATES
- How many pages have `loading.tsx`?
- How many pages have `error.tsx`?
- How many domain components show a polished empty state vs. just "No data"?

## 9. FORM PATTERNS
- Is `react-hook-form` used consistently?
- Zod schemas per form?
- Error message display — consistent?

## 10. INCONSISTENCIES / DESIGN DEBT
Scan for obvious patterns that break the brand:
- Different button styles / sizes across pages
- Mixed heading weights (some `font-semibold`, some `font-bold`)
- Hardcoded hex colors (forbidden per CLAUDE.md except 2 specific ones)
- Default Tailwind shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md` are forbidden — must use `shadow-soft*`)
- Inconsistent spacing
- Pages with raw `console.log` (forbidden)
- `any` types (forbidden)

Grep for these and report counts + example file paths.

## 11. EXISTING BRAND ASSETS
- Is there a logo/wordmark component? Where?
- Avatar/initials system — centralized?
- Icon system — all lucide? Any inline SVG?

Be concrete and exhaustive. Include line numbers and file paths for everything. This audit feeds the 12-sprint plan so precision matters more than brevity.
